title: SAP-ViT: A Self-Attributing Patch Vision Transformer for Medical Image Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.35593v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision Transformer (ViT) classifiers commonly rely on a global classification (CLS) token for image-level prediction, which is poorly aligned with local interpretability requirements in medical imaging. We propose SAP-ViT, a Self-Attributing Patch Vision Transformer that replaces CLS-based classification with direct aggregation of last-layer patch embeddings. This design makes class predictions decomposable into patch-level contributions as part of the forward pass. To encourage concise and readable evidence, SAP-ViT applies sparsity regularization to the patch-weight distribution. Since self-attention mixes information across patch tokens, we further introduce an input-space back-mapping mechanism to estimate which input patches contribute to influential output patch embeddings. translated_title: SAP-ViT：一种用于医学图像分类的自归因补丁视觉Transformer
translated_abstract: 视觉Transformer（ViT）分类器通常依赖全局分类（CLS）标记进行图像级预测，这与医学影像中对局部可解释性的要求并不契合。我们提出了SAP-ViT（自归因补丁视觉Transformer），它用最后一层补丁嵌入的直接聚合取代了基于CLS的分类方式。这一设计使得类别预测能够作为前向传播的一部分被分解为补丁级的贡献。为了促使模型给出简洁且可读的证据，SAP-ViT对补丁权重分布施加了稀疏正则化。由于自注意力机制会在补丁标记之间混合信息，我们进一步引入了一种输入空间回映射机制，用于估计哪些输入补丁对有影响力的输出补丁嵌入做出了贡献。我们在涵盖多种成像模态的多个医学图像分类数据集上对SAP-ViT进行了定性和定量评估。
tldr: SAP-ViT通过用最后一层补丁嵌入的直接聚合替代CLS标记分类，使医学图像分类预测天然可分解为补丁级贡献，并结合稀疏正则化与输入空间回映射机制实现内在可解释性。
en_tdlr: SAP-ViT replaces CLS-token classification with direct aggregation of last-layer patch embeddings, making medical image classification predictions naturally decomposable into patch-level contributions, enhanced by sparsity regularization and an input-space back-mapping mechanism for intrinsic interpretability.
